messages:
sasha: Heads up — hitting StrictMode crash on a couple of Sony Xperia devices when OkHttp's retry/backoff kicks in. Emulator (Pixel) doesn't repro. stacktrace shows StrictMode: network on main (weird because our call is inside Dispatchers.IO).

alex: That sounds like a thread-hopping bug. Are retries happening synchronously on the calling thread? Can you paste the OkHttp/Retrofit config you use?

sasha: Minimal repro in sample app attached to the ticket. Core snippet:

```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .build()

val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
  .client(client)
  .baseUrl("https://api.example.test/")
  .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
  .build()

// call from coroutine
withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { api.getStuff().execute() }
```

sasha: We expected the network to stay off main, but StrictMode logs show the retry sleep path runs on main on Xperia.

maria: Two hunches: 1) Some OEMs have flaky main-thread enforcement in their platform executors, 2) Retrofit's call adapter + our usage of execute() might be causing callback wiring to the main dispatcher somewhere. Have you tried setting a custom Dispatcher on OkHttp?

kevin: Also check if any interceptor does Thread.sleep() during retry — if an interceptor catches and retries synchronously without offloading, that could trigger StrictMode on OEMs with different thread scheduling.

alex: Try forcing OkHttp to use a dedicated dispatcher:

```kotlin
val dispatcher = Dispatcher(Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor())
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .dispatcher(dispatcher)
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .build()
```

alex: If that fixes it, we should document this OEM oddity in the SDK onboarding notes.

sasha: Quick test — swapped to a Dispatcher-backed client and ran the Xperia smoke. No StrictMode violation after ~30 runs. Looks promising.

maria: Long-term: we should audit our default client in the Android SDK. Maybe set a Dispatcher that uses a shared IO pool rather than inheriting platform defaults, or at least call out the behaviour in the README. I can file a small SDK PR.

kevin: Workaround we can recommend in release notes: set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) + implement coroutine-friendly retry with delay() on Dispatchers.IO. Safer for StrictMode.

ci-bot: ticket #RDW-4219 created: "okhttp retry triggers StrictMode on some OEMs; recommend explicit Dispatcher in client" (assigned to maria).

sasha: Thanks everyone — will update the sample app and add a short repro note in the onboarding checklist. :+1:
